#!/usr/bin/python3
import json
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path

DATA = Path('/var/lib/inventory/items.json')

class InventoryHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    server_version = 'Inventory/1.0'

    def send_json(self, status, payload):
        body = json.dumps(payload, separators=(',', ':')).encode()
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == '/health':
            self.send_json(200, {'status': 'ok', 'service': 'inventory'})
            return
        if self.path in ('/', '/api/inventory'):
            items = json.loads(DATA.read_text())
            self.send_json(200, {'service': 'inventory', 'items': items})
            return
        self.send_json(404, {'error': 'not found'})

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        print('%s - %s' % (self.address_string(), fmt % args), flush=True)

ThreadingHTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', 8181), InventoryHandler).serve_forever()
PYEOF
